response.text: Your goal is to pull the previous day's orders from your Shopify store through the API and add them to a Google Sheet with specific details while skipping duplicates and writing a log. My plan is as follows. First, I will handle kickoff and API credential setup for Shopify and Google Sheets. Second, I will develop a Python script to query Shopify orders from the previous day. I did nearly this for a warehouse database: wrote a Python service that listens to Shopify inventory webhooks, reconciles counts against PostgreSQL on a schedule and logs every change. What specific hosting environment or server will be used to run the daily scheduled script? Please reply so we can discuss the full plan.
